System Overview

FTMaintenance by FasTrak SoftWorks is a robust CMMS designed to help industrial organizations manage work orders, track assets, and control MRO inventory. It offers a solid balance of traditional EAM features with modern cloud accessibility.

💡 Editor's Verdict

FTMaintenance is a comprehensive maintenance solution with strong usability (7.8/10). Its combination of Work Order Management, MRO Inventory Management, Preventive Maintenance makes it a top consideration for modernizing plant operations.

Target Recommendation: Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Plastics maintenance and reliability teams.

Frequently Asked Questions

❓ What industries is FTMaintenance best suited for?

FTMaintenance is optimized for Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Plastics, Facilities maintenance and operations teams requiring Cloud / SaaS and On-Premise infrastructure.

❓ How does FTMaintenance handle work orders and preventive maintenance?

FTMaintenance provides end-to-end maintenance coordination, supporting reactive work order ticketing, recurring PM schedules, parts tracking, and technician mobile execution.

❓ What is the pricing model for FTMaintenance?

FTMaintenance operates on a Subscription pricing model with available tiers: Select, Premier, Enterprise.
